newsitem.title: CANADA: TD Bank cuts prime to 5.00 from 5.25.
newsitem.headline: TD Bank cuts prime to 5.00 from 5.25.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Monday it cut its prime lending rate to 5.00 percent from 5.25 percent, effective on Tuesday.
The move followed a Bank of Canada rate cut today of 25 basis points to 3.50 percent.
It matched identical moves by Bank of Montreal and Bank of Nova Scotia.
Canada's major banks last changed their prime lending rates on October 17, when they lowered them to 5.25 percent from 5.50 percent.
The prime rate is the rate charged by banks on loans to their best customers.
